questions.topicName: 机器学习与深度学习基础
questions.question: 把对话转成可计费的诊断编码。准确率门槛是多少，你如何按这个门槛构建？
questions.questionEn: Turn a conversation into billable diagnosis codes. What is the accuracy bar, and how do you build to it?

questions.topicName: 推理、服务与 GPU 性能
questions.question: 病历记录要在医生离开诊室之前就绪。给我做出延迟预算，并告诉我钱花在哪里。
questions.questionEn: The note should be ready before the clinician leaves the room. Build me the latency budget, and tell me where the money goes.

questions.question: 患者的病历（chart）里已经列出了用药。你会如何利用它来改进药名转写，又如何避免它适得其反？
questions.questionEn: The patient's chart already lists their medications. How would you use that to improve transcription of drug names, and how would you keep it from backfiring?

questions.question: 设计一个服务，把对话转成医嘱草稿：检验、影像、转诊、处方，通过针对 EHR 的 tool calls 完成。
questions.questionEn: Design a service that turns the conversation into draft orders: labs, imaging, referrals, prescriptions, via tool calls against the EHR.

sources.title: LLM 中的 Function Calling 是如何工作的？

questions.question: 请讲讲如何把完成的病历记录写回 Epic。哪里会出问题？
questions.questionEn: Walk me through writing a finished note back into Epic. What goes wrong?

questions.question: 两位优秀的医生对同一次就诊会写出不同的病历记录。那你究竟该如何评估病历记录质量？
questions.questionEn: Two good clinicians write different notes for the same visit. So how do you evaluate note quality at all?

questions.question: 编辑率是衡量医生信任度最直观的指标。它掩盖了什么，你会改用什么指标来埋点？
questions.questionEn: Edit rate is the obvious measure of clinician trust. What does it hide, and what would you instrument instead?

questions.topicName: 安全、安保与负责任 AI
questions.question: 生成的病历记录里出现了患者从未提到的药物。把它当作安全事件：你如何在医生看到之前检测出来？
questions.questionEn: A generated note contains a medication the patient never mentioned. Treat that as a safety incident: how do you detect it before a clinician sees it?

questions.topicName: 安全、安保与负责任 AI
questions.question: 医生不会签署自己无法核实的内容。你会如何构建 span 级溯源，把病历记录的每一行都追溯回对话？
questions.questionEn: Clinicians will not sign what they cannot verify. How would you build span-level provenance from every line of the note back to the conversation?

questions.topicName: 安全、安保与负责任 AI
questions.question: 你接触的每一个音频文件、转写文本和病历记录里都有 PHI。这会如何塑造架构，什么内容可以发给第三方模型 API？
questions.questionEn: PHI is in every audio file, transcript and note you touch. How does that shape the architecture, and what can you send to a third-party model API?

questions.topicName: 多模态、语音与声音 AI
questions.question: 我们的音频来自诊室：两三个说话人、背景噪声、口音，以及满是药名的词汇表。你会如何为这种场景构建并改进 ASR？
questions.questionEn: Our audio is a clinic room: two or three speakers, background noise, accents, and a vocabulary full of drug names. How would you build and improve the ASR for that?
